archetypes.name: dyn-run-identity
archetypes.rationale: The change unifies progress and bgjob ownership across lifecycle boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect changed progress, bgjob, design, and bootstrap paths for identity drift. Verify explicit and persisted run IDs retain precedence, legacy fallback occurs only when identity is absent, and delayed writers cannot target a replacement run. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
